Usage:
  agent-device longpress <x y|@ref|selector> [durationMs]

Hold a UI target by snapshot ref, selector, or coordinates to open a context menu or perform another hold gesture. Set durationMs when the default hold duration is unsuitable. Duration is positional, for example longpress @e12 800 or longpress 300 500 800.

Command flags:
  --settle             After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response (best-effort; never fails the action)
  --settle-quiet <ms>  Settle: quiet window the UI must hold to count as settled (default 500ms)
  --timeout <ms>       Boot/Open/Prepare: startup budget covering the device boot (and runner preparation for prepare). Replay/Snapshot/Test: maximum wall-clock time for the command or attempt. With --settle: the settle-wait deadline (default 10s)
  --depth, -d <depth>  Snapshot: limit snapshot depth
  --scope, -s <scope>  Snapshot: scope snapshot to label/identifier
  --raw                Snapshot: raw node output

Usage:
  agent-device gesture <pan|fling|swipe|pinch|rotate|transform|drag> ...

Perform a structured pan, fling, swipe, pinch, rotate, transform, or drag gesture. Select the gesture kind, then provide only the inputs that apply to that kind. Argument shapes: pan <x> <y> <dx> <dy> [durationMs], fling <up|down|left|right> <x> <y> [distance], swipe <left|right|left-edge|right-edge>, pinch <scale> [x] [y], rotate <degrees> [x] [y], transform <x> <y> <dx> <dy> <scale> <degrees> [durationMs], or drag <source-selector|pinned-ref> <destination-selector|pinned-ref> [sourceHoldMs] [moveMs] [destinationHoldMs]. For command plans, output only command lines. Android transform verification should use all app-observable effects, for example wait text "pan changed yes", wait text "pinch changed yes", and wait text "rotate changed yes", not exact transform values.

Command flags:
  --pointer-count <1|2>  Gesture pan: number of touch pointers (default 1)
